summary: On an empty string, USentenceBounds::size_hint subtracts 1 from an inner lower bound of 0. This panics with overflow checks enabled and otherwise wraps to usize::MAX, violating the iterator bound. The fix uses saturating_sub(1) for both bounds. The added test in tests/test.rs checks bounds against actual counts, starting with the empty string. The reversal includes the removed core::cmp import so the parent implementation can compile; intervening implementation text is unchanged. No tests were run.
